items.title: New price takes effect
items.quote: wir investieren weiter in den Ausbau unseres Glasfasernetzes. Deshalb erhöht sich der monatliche Grundpreis Ihres Tarifs „Muster DSL 250“ ab dem 01.04.2026 von 39,99 € auf 44,99 €.
items.computation: The letter states the new price applies from the calendar date 01.04.2026, printed explicitly, so no period calculation is needed.

items.title: Exercise special termination right (Sonderkündigungsrecht) due to price increase
items.quote: Sie können Ihren Vertrag innerhalb von drei Monaten nach Zugang dieser Mitteilung ohne Einhaltung einer Frist und ohne Kosten kündigen, frühestens zum Zeitpunkt des Wirksamwerdens der Änderung (§ 57 TKG).
items.computation: NetzMuster GmbH is a private company, not an authority, so the statutory Bekanntgabefiktion (deemed-delivery rule) for authorities does not apply; the letter also states no separate posting date. The letter is dated Monday 16.02.2026 (day of the event = Zugang, not counted per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB). Since no exact delivery date is stated, ordinary domestic letter post delivery time (~3 days) is assumed, giving an estimated Zugang on Thursday 19.02.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period of three months after an event ends on the day of the third following month bearing the same number as the day of the event: 19.02.2026 + 3 months = 19.05.2026 (Tuesday), which is not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday, so § 193 BGB does not shift it further. This is the last day the cancellation notice must reach NetzMuster GmbH to make use of the fee-free special termination right; the earliest effective date of such a termination would be 01.04.2026 as stated.

warnings: The exact delivery (Zugang) date of this letter is not stated; the deadline for the special termination right was estimated by adding ~3 days of typical postal transit to the printed letter date (16.02.2026), which is an assumption, not a fact stated in the letter — verify the actual date the letter was received and recalculate if different.
